LIVE_Y_DENOMINATOR.explanation: This ledger's denominator is the BRIDGE (every unit the bridge allocates), not Y-current's accepted identities. Y-current v11 accepts 3,986 work identities / 97,858,697 C0 rows; the bridge carries more because it includes units for works not in Y's accepted set. The delta is definitional, not a defect: STRUCTURE is derived per bridged unit; ACCEPTANCE is Y-current's own ruling. No row here claims acceptance, and this ledger changes no pointer.
LIVE_Y_DENOMINATOR.contract: consumers MUST join on Y-current's accepted set when acceptance matters; this ledger answers 'what structure does the bridge seal for this unit', never 'is this work accepted'
